posts.text:
A buyer once asked us why our 1 g sachet weighed 1.0 g and the last supplier's weighed 0.8 g.

Because fill weight is where a sachet maker saves money without anyone noticing. Under-fill by a fifth and the sachet still looks the same, still says 1 g, and runs out of capacity a week before the container docks.

Ours are filled to the stated weight with a tolerance we put in writing. Ask any supplier for that number before you compare prices.

https://www.drygelworld.com/silica-gel-packets

Every 25 kg bag on this pallet traces back to a mill certificate of analysis: bead size, bulk density, adsorption at 20, 50 and 90 percent humidity, moisture as packed.

We buy white bead from named mills, test it, and pack it air-tight in Karachi. That is the honest description of bulk supply from us, and the COA travels with the bag.

If you fill your own sachets, run breathers or drying cabinets, this is the product.

https://www.drygelworld.com/products/bulk-industrial

Kraft paper outside, bentonite clay inside. The whole sachet goes in the paper bin at the other end.

That is the reason apparel and footwear brands keep asking for clay: their retail packaging audits count every gram of plastic, and a clay sachet in kraft adds none.

Same moisture uptake as silica gel below 50 degrees C, lower cost per kilo, and a colour that does not look like something you should not eat.

https://www.drygelworld.com/products/dry-clay-desiccant

What arrives on your packing line: sachets counted into inner bags, inner bags into a master carton, carton sealed with the lot number and a pack date on the label.

The pack date matters more than people think. Sachets start working on the warehouse air the day the inner bag is opened, so open one inner bag at a time and keep the rest sealed.

We print the count, the gram size and the date on every carton so the line never has to guess.

https://www.drygelworld.com/products/paper-sachets

Bead size is a specification, not a detail.

2 to 5 mm is the workhorse: it fills a sachet evenly, does not sift through paper, and dries a carton at a steady rate. Finer grades adsorb faster but dust; coarser grades are for breathers and columns where air has to flow through the bed.

If a quotation does not state the bead size, ask. It changes the sachet, the price and the performance.

https://www.drygelworld.com/non-indicating-silica-gel

A 40 ft container on a 30-day passage through the tropics needs roughly 3 to 6 kg of desiccant hung inside it. Not one strip near the door.

The number comes from the air volume, the moisture the cargo itself gives off, the route humidity and the days at sea. We put the formula on the website so a forwarder can check our answer rather than take it on trust.

Strips in 1, 2, 3 and 5 kg, hooks included.

https://www.drygelworld.com/tools/container-desiccant-calculator

The humidity indicator card is the part of this picture most packers forget.

A moisture-barrier bag with a sachet inside protects the board. The card is what tells the person opening the bag six months later whether that protection held - and whether the board needs baking before reflow.

Sachet, barrier bag, indicator card: the three go together, and we supply the sachet and the card.

https://www.drygelworld.com/industries/electronics-packaging

Sialkot to Hamburg is about four weeks by sea. Leather goods carry enough of their own moisture to grow mould in half that time inside a sealed carton.

The fix is not more desiccant in the container. It is a sachet in every shoe box and a larger pack in every master carton, so the moisture leaving the leather is caught where it is released.

We size the two levels per product and per carton, for the leather and footwear exporters who cannot afford a white bloom on arrival.

https://www.drygelworld.com/silica-gel-for-leather-export

A packaging line does not want a new component. It wants the sachet to drop into the carton the way the last one did.

So we match what your line already runs: the same sachet dimensions, the same paper or non-woven, the same count per inner bag, printed the way your packers are used to reading it.

Send us the sachet you use now and we will quote a like-for-like.

https://www.drygelworld.com/packaging-desiccant-manufacturer

Clay desiccant is sold by the DIN 55473 unit, and that trips people up.

One unit is the desiccant that takes up at least 6 g of water at 40 percent humidity. For clay that is more grams of material than for silica gel, so a 16-unit clay pack is heavier than a 16-unit silica gel pack and does the same job.

Compare quotes by unit, not by gram weight, or the cheaper-looking offer is the one with less capacity.

https://www.drygelworld.com/products/dry-clay-desiccant

Where blue indicating gel still belongs: transformer breathers, compressed-air dryers, instrument cabinets - anywhere a technician looks at the sight glass and needs a colour that reads from across the room.

Where it does not: anything going into the EU, and anything near food. The indicator is cobalt(II) chloride, and we say so on the product page rather than in the small print.

For those cases we make the orange, cobalt-free grade.

https://www.drygelworld.com/blue-silica-gel-manufacturer

Open one of these bags and the beads should rattle, not clump. Clumping means the gel met moisture before it met you.

We heat-seal the inner liner at the factory and the bag stays that way until your line opens it. On the COA the adsorption figure is measured on dry bead; sealed packing is what makes that figure true at your end too.

25 kg bags, palletised, white non-indicating 2-5 mm.

https://www.drygelworld.com/bulk-silica-gel-desiccant

Every document in this picture is on the website, ungated, no email address required: the ISO 9001:2015 certificate with its number and registrar, the SDS, the COA, the DMF-free statement.

We also publish what we do not hold - REACH registration, FDA, food-contact certification - because a buyer finds out anyway, and it is better they hear it from us on page one than from customs on week six.

Download the pack, then ask for samples.

https://www.drygelworld.com/documentation

Distributors ask us two things about private label: what is the minimum, and what happens to my artwork between orders.

The minimum is a print run, not a container - small enough for a regional distributor to test a market. The artwork stays on file with us at no charge, so the second order is a phone call, not a project.

Your name on the sachet, our line behind it.

https://www.drygelworld.com/private-label

To quote you properly we need four things: the format and gram size, the quantity and whether it repeats, the destination port, and any documents your buyer needs with the shipment.

Send those and you get a written quotation within 24 business hours, from the people who make the sachets, on EXW, FOB Karachi, CIF or DAP terms.

Send fewer and you get four questions back first - which is why we are telling you now.
